tagline.en: Bernini — ByteDance's Apache-2.0 unified visual model spanning text/image-to-image and text/reference-to-video.
tagline.zh: Bernini——字节跳动的 Apache-2.0 统一视觉模型，覆盖文/图生图与文/参考生视频。

en: Bernini is a unified visual generation model from ByteDance, released under Apache-2.0. A single system handles a broad set of tasks: text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, video-to-video, and reference-conditioned video generation.

Its checkpoint combines a 7B semantic planner with a 14B renderer — the planner works out what to generate and the renderer produces the pixels. The official recipe runs multi-GPU with 8-way Ulysses inference for a single request. In WorldFoundry the official inference source is vendored in-tree and loaded from the self-contained Diffusers checkpoint.
Because the official route is designed for 8-way parallel inference on H100-class GPUs, Bernini targets serious multi-GPU setups rather than single-card use.
zh: Bernini 是字节跳动的统一视觉生成模型，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。单个系统即可处理一系列广泛任务：文生图、图生图、文生视频、视频生视频，以及参考条件的视频生成。
其 checkpoint 将 7B 的语义规划器与 14B 的渲染器结合——规划器决定生成什么，渲染器产出像素。官方配方针对单次请求采用 8 路 Ulysses 多 GPU 推理。在 WorldFoundry 中，官方推理源码被内置于代码树，并从自包含的 Diffusers checkpoint 加载。
由于官方路线为 H100 级 GPU 上的 8 路并行推理而设计，Bernini 面向严肃的多 GPU 环境，而非单卡使用。

whenToUse.en: Use Bernini when you want one openly-licensed model to cover both image and video generation across text, image, and reference conditioning — and you have multi-GPU hardware for its 8-way inference.
whenToUse.zh: 当你希望用一个开放许可的模型，在文本、图像与参考条件下同时覆盖图像与视频生成，并具备支持其 8 路推理的多 GPU 硬件时，选择 Bernini。

notFor.en: The official route assumes 8-way Ulysses inference on H100-class GPUs, so it is not suited to single-card or modest hardware.
notFor.zh: 官方路线假设在 H100 级 GPU 上做 8 路 Ulysses 推理，因此不适合单卡或普通硬件。

Official recipe uses 8-way Ulysses multi-GPU inference
